top_signals.title: China's stock market sinks into bear territory as CSI 300 extends 10-week rout
top_signals.summary: China's benchmark CSI 300 index has entered bear-market territory, falling 20% from its June peak, as a prolonged selloff in mainland equities deepens.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
